notes.title: Player Abilities And Zombies
notes.content:
Added Player Abilities
- Shield ( Create an impenetrable bubble that players can shoot out of but not in )
- Rocket Dash ( Evade players attacks by moving at high speed )

Added Early version of Zombies mode
- Rounds of increasing difficulty
- buy able doors and interfaces to progress through the level
- buy able weapons to help defeat the zombies
- Super Charger Machine to upgrade your weapons

notes.title: Gun Game And Free For all
notes.content:
Added New Game Modes
-Gun Game (6 Players Max, no bots)
-free for all (6 players Max, no bots)
-Added option to Disable Bots on Team death match

Upgraded Game Systems to allow Support of multiple game modes.
Capture the flag, dirty bomb and zombies to come in the future
